ValidationRule.description: Close date for Products added in Opportunity record should only allow for week days
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', $User.Profile_Name__c = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT(ISNULL(CloseDate)), CASE(MOD( CloseDate - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, 0, 6, 0, 1) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Weekends cannot be selected as Close date.
